name: Progress Form Master shuttering and deshuttering robot
summary: Robot system for precast pallet plants: a storage robot picks shutters from the shutter store by CAD data, the shuttering robot sets them on the pallet and activates their magnets, and the deshuttering robot scans, lifts and returns them for cleaning after curing. Made by Progress Maschinen & Automation in Brixen, South Tyrol (Italy), with one to three robots.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Progress Group from Brixen (Italy, EU); a customised Progress shuttering and deshuttering robot runs at Schwörer Bausysteme in Haigerloch-Stetten, Germany. No price published.

sellers.name: Progress Maschinen & Automation AG
sellers.note: Julius-Durst-Straße 100, I-39042 Brixen, Italy. Enquiry form on the website. Price on request.

specs.label: Robots per system
specs.quote: To increase production output, the entire system can be equipped with one, two or three robots.

specs.label: Shutter supply
specs.value: storage robot picks shutters by CAD data from the ebos control system
specs.quote: A storage robot selects the required shutters from the shuttering storage as directed by the CAD data transmitted by the ebos® control system.

specs.label: Deshuttering
specs.value: scans, identifies and picks up the shutters automatically
specs.quote: On removal of the elements the deshuttering robot scans the shutters, identifies them and picks them up fully automatically.

specs.label: Element types
specs.value: slab elements and double walls; solid slabs, solid walls and sandwich elements; combined plants
specs.quote: for the production of solid slabs, solid walls and sandwich elements

specs.label: Centimetre shuttering
specs.value: patented system for shuttering in 1 cm steps without filler pieces
specs.quote: Accurate shuttering to the centimetre without using filling elements such as polystyrene becomes reality with this patented shuttering system.

specs.label: Magnets
specs.value: activates the integral magnets in the shutters
specs.quote: then activates the integral magnets in the shutters

notes: Gantry (portal) robots over the pallet line; arms counts the largest configuration of three robots.
Can be fitted into existing plants; pallet cleaning device fixed or mobile.
Progress also offers a Mesh Spacer robot that places concrete-cover spacers on the pallet (not included here).

images.alt: Yellow Progress Group shuttering robot gantry with a vertical gripper axis over a steel pallet with placed shutters

evidence.task: Customised shuttering robot positions shuttering elements, magnets and mounting sleeves on the pallet; a deshuttering robot removes the shutters before pallet cleaning
evidence.note: BFT International 05/2021; the article does not use the name Form Master. The article says the pallet cleaning device of Ebawe is part of the system.
